summarize_task_to_xml: summarize the task_to_xml function that maps task names to MJX XML scene paths
run_task_to_xml_flat: run task_to_xml with 'flat_terrain' to get the feet-only flat terrain XML path
run_task_to_xml_rough: run task_to_xml with 'rough_terrain' to get the feet-only rough terrain XML path
review_FEET_SITES: review the FEET_SITES constant listing left_foot and right_foot site names
review_RESTRICTED_JOINT_RANGE: review the RESTRICTED_JOINT_RANGE constant defining joint limits for all G1 robot joints
